That has been very useful for people using agents to work with Fly. But, it was always missing the rest of Fly. Now, we have a single MCP server with access to all of your Fly resources: [https://mcp.fly.io/](https://mcp.fly.io/) Visit that URL in your browser and you’ll get all the details about how to hook up the MCP server to your agent. Or, just point your agent at it and let it rip. You can manage machines, volumes, apps, and sprites. MPG is coming soon! This is currently in beta (mostly because it doesn’t have every single possible tool yet) so please share your feedback with us. The existing Sprites MCP is unchanged and we have no immediate plans to deprecate it. 205 views 7 likes 2 links [![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/aezell_fly/48/43735_2.png)3](https://community.fly.io/u/aezell_fly "aezell_fly") [![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/timovink/48/51126_2.png)2](https://community.fly.io/u/TimoVink "TimoVink") [![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/kyle/48/51406_2.png)](https://community.fly.io/u/kyle "kyle") ## post by TimoVink on Oct 23 [![](https://sea1.discourse-cdn.com/fly1/user_avatar/community.fly.io/timovink/48/51126_2.png)](https://community.fly.io/u/timovink) [TimoVink](https://community.fly.io/u/timovink) 1 [17d](https://community.fly.io/t/new-fly-mcp/28906/2 "Post date") Heyo. Very exciting, looking forward to trying it out! I just tried connecting, but the Authorize button during the consent flow is greyed out. Quick peek at the JS shows there is a `data-server-disabled` flag being set – perhaps it still needs a button click on your end to release it to the world? Edit: FYI, this only seems to be a client-side check?
